<!--
Thanks for the PR! A few quick checks before you mark it ready.
See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full development guide.
-->

### Summary
One or two sentences on what this changes and why.

### Checklist
- [ ] Tests for new behavior
- [ ] Lint + format pass locally (`uv run ruff` / `npm run lint` + `npm run format:check`)
- [ ] User-facing strings warmed (no internal sigils, TODOs, or placeholder copy)
- [ ] If schema changed: migration notes included (DDB attributes, env vars, IAM)
- [ ] Linked issue or VISION.md item

### Notes for the reviewer
Anything tricky, anything you're unsure about, anything you punted on.
